build_sequence_features: build a feature dict with one-hot encoded amino acid types and residue indices from a protein sequence
build_msa_features: build a feature dict with integer-encoded MSA alignments, deletion matrices, and species identifiers from multiple MSAs
run_msa_tool: run an MSA tool like Jackhmmer or HHBlits against a FASTA file and write results to a Stockholm or A3M output path
run_data_pipeline: run the full AlphaFold data pipeline to assemble sequence features, MSA features, and template features from a FASTA input
review_datapipeline_class: review the DataPipeline class that orchestrates Jackhmmer, HHBlits, HHSearch, and HMMSearch alignment tools for AlphaFold input generation
